    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
      AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT CDSCode, County, District, AdmFName2
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
      AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT CDSCode, County, District, AdmFName3
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
      AND AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM school_admins
    GROUP BY first_name
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM name_counts
    ORDER BY school_count DESC, first_name COLLATE BINARY ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT County, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
),
district_counts AS (
    SELECT County, District, first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM school_admins
    WHERE first_name IN (SELECT first_name FROM top_names)
    GROUP BY County, District, first_name
)
SELECT d.District, n.first_name, COALESCE(c.school_count, 0) AS school_count
FROM districts AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS n
LEFT JOIN district_counts AS c
    ON c.County = d.County
   AND c.District = d.District
   AND c.first_name = n.first_name
ORDER BY d.District, n.first_name COLLATE BINARY;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`, 0)), 2)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
 AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

        s.School,
        s.AdmEmail1,
        s.AdmEmail2,

    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'

),
top_score AS (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) AS NumGE1500
    FROM school_scores
)
SELECT
    school_scores.School,
    COALESCE(school_scores.AdmEmail1, school_scores.AdmEmail2, school_scores.AdmEmail3) AS AdministratorEmail
FROM school_scores
JOIN top_score ON school_scores.NumGE1500 = top_score.NumGE1500;

SELECT

    Latitude

    FROM schools
    WHERE Latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND (SOCType LIKE '%Middle%' OR School LIKE '%Middle%')
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND s.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND s.DOCType IN (
      'Elementary School District',
      'High School District',
      'Unified School District'
  );

SELECT
    s.FundingType,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_2014_2015_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100), 2) AS average_frpm_eligible_percentage,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
                 AND sa.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
                 AND sa.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
                THEN sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS average_combined_sat_score
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.FundingType;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    f.`Low Grade` AS earliest_grade_level,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS k12_enrollment,
    COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    CASE f.`Low Grade`
        WHEN 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN 'K' THEN 1
        WHEN '1' THEN 2
        WHEN '2' THEN 3
        WHEN '3' THEN 4
        WHEN '4' THEN 5
        WHEN '5' THEN 6
        WHEN '6' THEN 7
        WHEN '7' THEN 8
        WHEN '8' THEN 9
        WHEN '9' THEN 10
        WHEN '10' THEN 11
        WHEN '11' THEN 12
        WHEN '12' THEN 13
    END DESC,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC,
    s.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND (
    CASE
      WHEN INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') > 0
        THEN CAST(SUBSTR(s.GSserved, INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER)
      WHEN s.GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*'
        THEN CAST(s.GSserved AS INTEGER)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) <= 8
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0;

SELECT
    f.`Charter Funding Type`,
    COUNT(*) AS currently_operating_schools,
    SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    SUM(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY f.`Charter Funding Type`
ORDER BY CASE f.`Charter Funding Type`
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.District,
        s.County,
        t.AvgScrWrite,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS t
        ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
      AND t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School, District, County, AvgScrWrite
FROM eligible
WHERE score_rank = 2
ORDER BY School;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_taker_schools
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name` AS county,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter,
        ROUND(
            f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
            2
        ) AS free_pct,
        ROUND(
            f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
            2
        ) AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm AS f
    WHERE f.`County Name` = (
        SELECT `County Name`
        FROM frpm
        WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
    )
      AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
),
sat AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total_score
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    e.county,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(e.free_pct), 2) AS average_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_pct), 2) AS average_frpm_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(s.total_score), 2) AS average_sat_score
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN sat AS s
    ON s.cds = e.CDSCode
GROUP BY e.county;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS average_schools_per_month
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Diego'
  AND DOCType IN (
    'Elementary School District',
    'High School District',
    'Unified School District'
  )
  AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
  AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
)
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.District AS district,
    s.City AS city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_frpm_k12,
    t.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
    t.AvgScrRead AS average_reading_score,
    t.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
    t.AvgScrWrite AS average_writing_score,
    t.NumGE1500 AS test_takers_total_score_at_least_1500
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    printf('%.4f', f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    s.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND (s.GSserved LIKE '%-12' OR s.GSserved = '12')
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" = (
      SELECT MAX(f2."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f2."Enrollment (K-12)")
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN frpm AS f2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.County = 'Alameda'
        AND (s2.GSserved LIKE '%-12' OR s2.GSserved = '12')
        AND f2."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  );

SELECT
    sch.School AS school_name,
    sch.Phone AS phone_number,
    sch.Website AS website,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS average_sat_reading,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS average_sat_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_sat_writing,
    CASE WHEN sch.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_charter,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12_2014_2015,
    ROUND(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100, 2) AS frpm_eligible_percentage,
    high.highest_sat_math_score,
    high.highest_sat_math_score - sat.AvgScrMath AS points_below_highest
FROM schools AS sch
JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
JOIN frpm
    ON frpm.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
   AND frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(s.AvgScrMath) AS highest_sat_math_score
    FROM satscores AS s
    JOIN schools AS active_school
        ON active_school.CDSCode = s.cds
    WHERE active_school.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND s.NumTstTakr >= 10
) AS high
WHERE CAST(sch.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = 7618040113118;

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.County,
        s.School,
        sat.AvgScrRead
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
        ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        school_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY school_count DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM county_counts
),
county_max_reads AS (
    SELECT County, MAX(AvgScrRead) AS max_read
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT
    rc.County,
    rc.school_count,
    COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(vs.School, ', '), 'None') AS school_names
FROM ranked_counties AS rc
JOIN county_max_reads AS cm
    ON cm.County = rc.County
LEFT JOIN virtual_schools AS vs
    ON vs.County = rc.County
   AND cm.max_read IS NOT NULL
   AND vs.AvgScrRead = cm.max_read
WHERE rc.county_rank <= 5
GROUP BY rc.County, rc.school_count
ORDER BY rc.school_count DESC, rc.County;

WITH target_counties AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Santa Barbara'
       OR CDSCode = '01100170109835'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
    FROM schools
    WHERE Virtual = 'F'
      AND County IN (SELECT County FROM target_counties)
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT tc.County, COALESCE(cc.exclusive_virtual_schools, 0) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT County FROM target_counties) AS tc
LEFT JOIN county_counts AS cc ON cc.County = tc.County
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, tc.County ASC;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.County,
        s.City,
        s.MailStreet,
        s.MailCity,
        s.MailState,
        s.MailZip,
        s.Website,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS frpm_share,
        s.OpenDate,
        s.ClosedDate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND s.Charter = 0
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
),
largest AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_count = (SELECT MAX(frpm_count) FROM eligible)
),
smallest_share AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_count IS NOT NULL
      AND frpm_share = (
          SELECT MIN(frpm_share)
          FROM eligible
          WHERE frpm_count IS NOT NULL
      )
),
selected AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, 1 AS part_order FROM largest
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, 'smallest FRPM share', 2 FROM smallest_share
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, 'the CDS code from my notes', 3
    FROM eligible
    WHERE CDSCode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT
    selected.part,
    e.School AS school_name,
    e.County AS county,
    e.City AS city,
    e.MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    e.MailCity AS mailing_city,
    e.MailState AS mailing_state,
    e.MailZip AS mailing_ZIP,
    e.Website AS website,
    e.enrollment_k12 AS k12_enrollment,
    e.frpm_count AS frpm_eligible_student_count,
    e.frpm_share AS frpm_share,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS average_total_sat_score,
    sat.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS percentage_sat_takers_scoring_1500_or_more,
    e.OpenDate AS opening_date,
    CASE WHEN e.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM selected
JOIN eligible AS e ON e.CDSCode = selected.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = e.CDSCode
ORDER BY selected.part_order, e.CDSCode;

SELECT s.School AS name, s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
  AND f.`High Grade` IN ('K', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8');

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Low Grade" GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
ORDER BY s.CDSCode;

SELECT
    s.cname AS county_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cds) AS qualifying_schools
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY s.cname
ORDER BY qualifying_schools DESC, county_name ASC;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '01611430131177'
)
  AND ss.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY ss.NumGE1500 DESC, s.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sch.Street, sch.City, sch.Zip, sch.State
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr >= 700
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(s.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS magnet_school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.City IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."School Type" IN (
      'High Schools (Public)',
      'Continuation High Schools',
      'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)'
  )
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT
    f."County Name" AS county_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
GROUP BY f."County Name";

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND (
    cardKingdomId IS NULL OR trim(cardKingdomId) = ''
    OR cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL OR trim(cardKingdomFoilId) = ''
  );

WITH printing_ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.uuid,
        c.name,
        c.artist,
        c.isPromo,
        COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, artist, isPromo
FROM printing_ruling_counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM printing_ruling_counts)
ORDER BY name, artist, isPromo;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
   AND fd.language = 'French'
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'a'
ORDER BY id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.borderColor = 'white'
  AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR instr(c.power, '*') > 0)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM rulings AS r
      WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
        AND instr(lower(r.text), 'triggered ability') > 0
  );

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE LOWER(l.format) = 'commander'
  AND LOWER(l.status) = 'legal';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f
    ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    AND f.language = 'French'
WHERE c.power IS NULL
   OR instr(c.power, '*') > 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code)
FROM sets AS s
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND st.language = 'Italian';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cardKingdomId) <> ''
             AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cardKingdomFoilId) <> ''
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'CSP';

WITH banned_formats AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY format
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MAX(record_count)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count
            FROM legalities
            WHERE status = 'Banned'
            GROUP BY format
        )
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT bf.format, c.name
FROM banned_formats AS bf
JOIN legalities AS l
    ON l.format = bf.format
JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY bf.format, c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS n
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
 AND l.format = 'brawl'
 AND l.status = 'Legal'
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%';

SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year_span
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 10;

WITH translation_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
    FROM set_translations
    GROUP BY setCode
),
qualifying_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS t
        ON t.setCode = s.code
    WHERE COALESCE(t.translation_count, 0) < 5
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards AS c
JOIN qualifying_sets AS q
    ON q.code = c.setCode;

WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT
    s.type AS set_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN s.code END) AS translated_set_count,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ts.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) ELSE 0 END),
        0
    ) AS translated_set_card_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translated_sets AS ts ON ts.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.date)
    FROM rulings r2
    JOIN cards c2 ON c2.uuid = r2.uuid
    WHERE c2.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  );

WITH artist_counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS creature_card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND artist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE creature_card_count = (
  SELECT MAX(creature_card_count)
  FROM artist_counts
)
ORDER BY artist;

WITH newest_version AS (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
)
SELECT c.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN newest_version AS n ON c.frameVersion = n.frameVersion
GROUP BY c.frameVersion;

WITH frame_counts AS (
    SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS printing_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
    GROUP BY frameVersion
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT frameVersion
    FROM frame_counts
    ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CAST(latest.frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS year,
    ROUND(100.0 * frame_counts.printing_count / total.printing_count, 2) AS percentage
FROM latest
JOIN frame_counts ON frame_counts.frameVersion = latest.frameVersion
CROSS JOIN total;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE ',' || keywords || ',' LIKE '%,Flying,%'
  AND ',' || keywords || ',' LIKE '%,Cycling,%';

WITH abyssal_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code) AS rn
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT code, name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC) AS rn
    FROM sets
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT code, name FROM abyssal_sets WHERE rn = 1
    UNION
    SELECT code, name FROM latest_set WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT chosen.name AS set_name,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                    AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> ''
                    AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END
           ) / COUNT(c.id),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM chosen
JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = chosen.code
GROUP BY chosen.code, chosen.name
ORDER BY chosen.code;

SELECT c.name,
       c.number AS collector_number,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM foreign_data AS f
        WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM cards AS c
WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'abzan'
  AND CAST(c.number AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(number AS INTEGER))
      FROM cards
      WHERE lower(watermark) = 'abzan'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
  AND (',' || keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flash,%'
  AND convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
      AND (',' || keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flash,%'
  )
ORDER BY name;

SELECT
    s.name,
    s.keyruneCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations st
      WHERE st.setCode = s.code
        AND st.language <> 'English'
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'b'
  AND hasFoil = 0
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, artist
    FROM cards
    WHERE borderColor = 'black'
      AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
      AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
),
counts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY artist;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE hasContentWarning = 1
  AND availability = 'paper';

SELECT
    s.type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.language = 'Japanese'
         AND t.translation IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
        THEN s.id
    END) AS japanese_name_sets
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t
    ON t.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist)
FROM cards
WHERE availability IN ('arena', 'arena,paper')
  AND borderColor = 'black'
  AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 5
  AND artist IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.setCode IN (
    SELECT s.code
    FROM cards AS ac
    JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = ac.setCode
    WHERE ac.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
      AND s.releaseDate = (
          SELECT MAX(s2.releaseDate)
          FROM cards AS ac2
          JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = ac2.setCode
          WHERE ac2.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
      )
)
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) > CAST(c.toughness AS REAL);

SELECT frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND leadershipSkills LIKE '%''commander'': True%'
  AND frameVersion = 'future'
GROUP BY frameVersion;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball';

SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(ruling_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
        FROM cards AS c2
        JOIN rulings AS r2 ON r2.uuid = c2.uuid
        WHERE c2.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
        GROUP BY c2.name
    )
)
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT c.colors AS card_color,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) AS legal_format_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.colors
ORDER BY c.colors;

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
GROUP BY frameVersion
ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)
    ELSE -1
END DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), cardKingdomId
LIMIT 3;

WITH type_counts AS (
    SELECT c.type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
            AND f.language <> 'English'
      )
    GROUP BY c.type
)
SELECT type, card_count
FROM type_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM type_counts);

WITH guild_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.watermark AS guild,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS f
        ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE lower(c.watermark) IN (
        'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
        'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
    )
      AND f.language <> 'English'
    GROUP BY c.watermark
)
SELECT guild, card_count
FROM guild_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM guild_counts);

SELECT
    c.type AS card_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'azorius'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data AS f
      WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
        AND f.language IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY c.type
ORDER BY card_count DESC, c.type COLLATE BINARY ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion IN ('2015', 'future')
  AND text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(text) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(otherFaceIds) <> ''
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT frameVersion
      FROM cards
      WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
      ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND layout IN ('split', 'transform', 'adventure', 'modal_dfc', 'aftermath', 'meld', 'flip')
  AND date(replace(originalReleaseDate, '/', '-')) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
ORDER BY name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
    SELECT c.setCode, c.number
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid AND f.language = 'French'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS i
          WHERE i.uuid = c.uuid AND i.language = 'Italian'
      )
    GROUP BY c.setCode, c.number
);

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.type = (
    SELECT type
    FROM sets
    WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS t
    WHERE t.setCode = s.code
)
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
  AND c.frameVersion = (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion)
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
  )
  AND s.releaseDate = (
    SELECT MAX(s2.releaseDate)
    FROM cards AS c2
    JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE c2.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
      AND c2.frameVersion = (
        SELECT MAX(frameVersion)
        FROM cards
        WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
      )
  )
GROUP BY s.name, s.releaseDate;

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS t
      WHERE t.setCode = s.code
        AND t.language = 'Spanish'
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT SUM(convertedManaCost)
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(originalReleaseDate, 1, instr(originalReleaseDate, '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) = 2013;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT
    s.block AS block_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS sets_with_official_translated_name,
    SUM(s.baseSetSize) AS total_base_set_cards
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS st
      WHERE st.setCode = s.code
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  )
GROUP BY s.block
ORDER BY s.block;

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fd.name AS japanese_name,
        c.type AS english_type,
        c.uuid
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
ruling_totals AS (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT
    q.japanese_name,
    q.english_type,
    SUM(COALESCE(rt.ruling_count, 0)) AS total_rulings
FROM qualifying AS q
LEFT JOIN ruling_totals AS rt
    ON rt.uuid = q.uuid
GROUP BY q.japanese_name, q.english_type
ORDER BY q.japanese_name, q.english_type;

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT st.language, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS printing_count
    FROM set_translations AS st
    JOIN cards AS c
        ON c.setCode = st.setCode
    JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
       AND fd.language = st.language
    WHERE fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
    GROUP BY st.language
),
minimum_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(printing_count) AS printing_count
    FROM counts
)
SELECT counts.language, counts.printing_count
FROM counts
JOIN minimum_count
    ON counts.printing_count = minimum_count.printing_count
ORDER BY counts.language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) >= 10
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM cards AS p
      JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = p.setCode
      WHERE p.scryfallOracleId = c.scryfallOracleId
        AND st.language = 'French'
  );

WITH banned_creatures AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId, c.convertedManaCost
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
      AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
      AND l.status = 'Banned'
      AND c.scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(convertedManaCost), 1)
FROM banned_creatures;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

WITH official_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT language
    FROM set_translations
),
language_printings AS (
    SELECT fd.language, COUNT(*) AS printing_count
    FROM foreign_data AS fd
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
    JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
    JOIN official_languages AS ol ON ol.language = fd.language
    GROUP BY fd.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM language_printings
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM language_printings)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.text) <> '';

WITH commander_sets AS (
    SELECT id, code, name, releaseDate
    FROM sets
    WHERE lower(type) = 'commander'
      AND releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
      AND releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id,
           s.code,
           s.name,
           COUNT(c.id) AS total_card_count
    FROM commander_sets s
    LEFT JOIN sets related
      ON related.parentCode = s.code
    LEFT JOIN cards c
      ON c.setCode = s.code
      OR c.setCode = related.code
    WHERE c.isOnlineOnly = 0 OR c.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY s.id, s.code, s.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_card_count DESC) AS card_rank
    FROM card_counts
)
SELECT r.id,
       r.name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT language)
        FROM set_translations t
        WHERE t.setCode = r.code) AS official_language_count
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.card_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.id ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(fd.language) <> '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
  AND f.language IS NOT NULL
  AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.flavorText) <> '';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
  AND ph.UserId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        substr(Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Name = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS student_badges,
        COUNT(*) AS all_badges
    FROM badges
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2011')
    GROUP BY substr(Date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT
    100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2010' THEN student_badges END)
          / MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2010' THEN all_badges END)
  - 100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2011' THEN student_badges END)
          / MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2011' THEN all_badges END)
    AS difference_in_percentage_points
FROM yearly;

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer game datasets';

SELECT c.Text, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, c.UserDisplayName) AS AuthorDisplayName
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = c.PostId
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC, c.Id DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH highest_reputation_users AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM posts AS p
JOIN highest_reputation_users AS u
    ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id;

WITH single_comment_posts AS (
    SELECT PostId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY PostId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM comments c
JOIN single_comment_posts s ON s.PostId = c.PostId
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.Score = 0;

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM comments AS c
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE instr(c.Text, 'http://') > 0;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges AS organizer
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = organizer.UserId
WHERE organizer.Name = 'Organizer'
  AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
  AND organizer.Date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM badges AS prior
      WHERE prior.UserId = organizer.UserId
        AND prior.Date < organizer.Date
  ) >= 5;

WITH first_posts AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS first_post_date
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_count
FROM first_posts AS fp
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
WHERE fp.first_post_date >= '2010-01-01'
  AND fp.first_post_date < '2011-01-01'
  AND TRIM(u.Location) = 'India';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS avg_reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Score < 20
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH germany_last_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
post_groups AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
                THEN 'Germany-based last editor'
            ELSE 'All other posts'
        END AS post_group,
        SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY post_group
),
editor_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS editor_count,
        SUM(Reputation) AS combined_reputation
    FROM germany_last_editors
)
SELECT
    pg.post_group,
    pg.total_score,
    es.editor_count AS germany_last_editor_user_count,
    es.combined_reputation AS germany_users_combined_reputation
FROM post_groups pg
CROSS JOIN editor_stats es
ORDER BY CASE pg.post_group
    WHEN 'Germany-based last editor' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
END;

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation)
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.Score = 10
      AND p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
      AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
);

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.LasActivityDate >= '2014-08-27'
  AND p.LasActivityDate < '2014-08-28'
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<R>%';

SELECT SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS l
JOIN posts AS p
  ON p.Id = CASE
      WHEN l.PostId = 4220 THEN l.RelatedPostId
      ELSE l.PostId
  END
WHERE (l.PostId = 4220 OR l.RelatedPostId = 4220)
  AND p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH german_user_badge_counts AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
    FROM users AS u
    LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location = 'Germany'
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
ranked_totals AS (
    SELECT badge_total,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS total_rank
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT badge_total FROM german_user_badge_counts)
)
SELECT g.DisplayName, g.badge_total
FROM german_user_badge_counts AS g
JOIN ranked_totals AS r ON r.badge_total = g.badge_total
WHERE r.total_rank = 2
ORDER BY g.DisplayName;

SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
  AND Location NOT LIKE '%Canada%'
  AND Views = (
      SELECT MAX(Views)
      FROM users
      WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
        AND Location NOT LIKE '%Canada%'
  );

SELECT Age
FROM users
WHERE Location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')
  AND Reputation = (
      SELECT MAX(Reputation)
      FROM users
      WHERE Location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId) AS user_count
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Yearling'
  AND u.Location = 'India'
  AND b.Date < '2014-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.DisplayName) AS display_name_count
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65;

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
related_counts AS (
    SELECT c.Id, c.Title, COUNT(pl.Id) AS related_count
    FROM candidates AS c
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
        ON pl.PostId = c.Id
       AND pl.LinkTypeId = 1
    GROUP BY c.Id, c.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_count
FROM related_counts
WHERE related_count = (SELECT MAX(related_count) FROM related_counts)
ORDER BY Title;

SELECT Id
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Michael'
ORDER BY CreationDate ASC, Id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), p.OwnerDisplayName)) AS user_count
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND (p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL OR p.OwnerDisplayName IS NOT NULL);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation), 2)
FROM users AS u
WHERE TRIM(LOWER(u.Location)) = 'india'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts AS p
      WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
        AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
        AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  );

WITH prolific_users AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId AS UserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
upvotes_cast AS (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(*) AS UpVotesCast
    FROM votes
    WHERE VoteTypeId = 2
      AND UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(upvotes_cast.UpVotesCast, 0)), 2) AS AverageUpVotesCast,
    ROUND(AVG(users.Age), 2) AS AverageAge
FROM prolific_users
JOIN users ON users.Id = prolific_users.UserId
LEFT JOIN upvotes_cast ON upvotes_cast.UserId = prolific_users.UserId;

WITH months(month_num) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_num + 1
    FROM months
    WHERE month_num < 12
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pl.PostId) AS post_count
    FROM postLinks AS pl
    JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
    WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND p.PostTypeId = 1
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mc.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_posts_per_month
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts AS mc ON mc.month_num = m.month_num;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN u.Reputation < 1000 OR u.Reputation IS NULL OR u.Id IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND p.Score > 5;

WITH editor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DisplayName, ''), NULLIF(ph.UserDisplayName, '')) AS editor_display_name,
        COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
    WHERE ph.PostId = (
        SELECT Id
        FROM posts
        WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
    )
      AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4, 5)
    GROUP BY ph.UserId, editor_display_name
)
SELECT editor_display_name, edit_comment_count
FROM editor_counts
WHERE edit_comment_count = (SELECT MAX(edit_comment_count) FROM editor_counts)
ORDER BY editor_display_name;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date >= '201301'
      AND y.Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total, CustomerID
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_totals
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
        2
    ) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(
        (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),
        2
    ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(
        (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'SME'),
        2
    ) AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        ROUND(100.0 * (total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012, 2) AS increase_percentage
    FROM totals
)
SELECT Segment, increase_percentage
FROM percentages
WHERE increase_percentage = (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) FROM percentages)
   OR increase_percentage = (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) FROM percentages)
ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC, Segment;

WITH customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND Price = 634.8
),
annual_totals AS (
    SELECT substr(Date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer)
      AND substr(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY substr(Date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total END) -
     MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total END)) /
     MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total END),
    4
) AS relative_change
FROM annual_totals;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM yearmonth AS y2012
      WHERE y2012.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        AND y2012.Date >= '201201'
        AND y2012.Date < '201301'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM yearmonth AS y2013
      WHERE y2013.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        AND y2013.Date >= '201301'
        AND y2013.Date < '201401'
  );

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201' AND Date <= '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(Consumption) < 30000
) AS annual
    ON annual.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      AND t.Date >= '2012-01-01'
      AND t.Date < '2013-01-01'
)
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date >= '201301'
  AND y.Date < '201401'
  AND y.Consumption > 0
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT CAST(
    (julianday(MAX(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time)) -
     julianday(MIN(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time))) * 1440
    AS INTEGER
) AS elapsed_minutes
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g
    ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Price > 1000;

WITH steady_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201311'
      AND Consumption > 0
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Date) = 11
)
SELECT c.Currency, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM steady_customers AS s
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Currency;

WITH quarterly AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS quarter_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Currency,
    ROUND(AVG(q.quarter_consumption), 2) AS average_quarter_consumption
FROM quarterly q
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY c.Currency
ORDER BY c.Currency;

SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total END),
    0
) AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS year, Date, SUM(Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201' AND Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY year, Date
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Consumption), 2) AS average_monthly_fuel_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 15621
  AND Date >= '201301'
  AND Date < '201401'
  AND Consumption > 0;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201' AND Date <= '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT c.Currency, AVG(a.consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM annual a
    JOIN customers c USING (CustomerID)
    WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
    GROUP BY c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM avgs;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT y.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date >= '201301'
      AND y.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) > 1000000
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date = '201302'
  AND y.Consumption > 0;

WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM away_wins AS w
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = w.away_team_api_id
WHERE w.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM away_wins)
ORDER BY t.team_long_name;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS a
JOIN Team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id = a.team_api_id
WHERE a.date >= '2012-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2013-01-01'
  AND a.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE date >= '2012-01-01'
        AND date < '2013-01-01'
  );

SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    p.height,
    AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND pa.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal);

WITH extreme_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
       OR height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
),
average_finishing AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, AVG(a.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM extreme_players p
    JOIN Player_Attributes a ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM average_finishing
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

WITH named_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
),
latest_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        n.player_name,
        pa.overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY n.player_api_id
            ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM named_players n
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa
        ON pa.player_api_id = n.player_api_id
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) AS ariel_rating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END) AS paulin_rating
    FROM latest_ratings
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND((ariel_rating - paulin_rating) * 100.0 / paulin_rating, 2) AS percentage_higher
FROM ratings;

SELECT MIN(pa.date) AS date
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Player_Attributes pa
            WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
              AND pa.overall_rating > 70
        ) THEN p.player_api_id
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Player p
WHERE p.height < 180;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
WHERE p.height > 180;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.defensive_work_rate = 'high' THEN p.player_api_id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
  AND a.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL;

WITH ratings AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2010-12-31'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM ratings
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND overall_rating > 80
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM (
        SELECT m.id, e.player_api_id
        FROM "Match" AS m
        JOIN eligible AS e
          ON e.player_api_id IN (
              m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3,
              m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
              m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9,
              m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1,
              m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
              m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7,
              m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10,
              m.away_player_11
          )
        WHERE m.season = '2010/2011'
    )
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(match_count), 2)
FROM player_matches;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player p
JOIN ranked r ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND LOWER(TRIM(r.defensive_work_rate)) <> 'medium';

WITH risky_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
attributes_as_of_date AS (
    SELECT
        team_api_id,
        chanceCreationPassing,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY team_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2014-09-19'
)
SELECT
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS club_count,
    ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM risky_teams AS r
JOIN Team AS t
    ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN attributes_as_of_date AS a
    ON a.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
   AND a.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) > 1
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, t.team_short_name ASC;

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_attributes AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE a.rn = 1
  AND a.defensive_work_rate = 'medium'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1995
  AND p.height IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1) AS average_weight
FROM Player AS p
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
);

    UNION ALL SELECT id, season, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT id, season, away_player_3 FROM "Match"

)
SELECT p.player_name, COALESCE(pm.matches_played, 0) AS matches_played
FROM Player AS p
LEFT JOIN player_matches AS pm ON pm.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Adam%'
  AND p.weight > 170;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'POR'
  AND t.team_long_name = 'Portsmouth'
  AND ta.date >= '2015-09-10'
  AND ta.date < '2015-09-11';

WITH eligible_matches AS (
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        m.date AS match_date
    FROM "Match" AS m
    WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
rated_matches AS (
    SELECT
        em.match_id,
        em.team_api_id,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY em.match_id
            ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM eligible_matches AS em
    JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta
      ON ta.team_api_id = em.team_api_id
     AND ta.date <= em.match_date
)
SELECT
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name AS short_name,
    COUNT(*) AS home_wins
FROM rated_matches AS rm
JOIN Team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id = rm.team_api_id
WHERE rm.rn = 1
  AND rm.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
ORDER BY home_wins DESC, t.team_long_name, t.team_api_id;

WITH heavy_loss AS (
    SELECT season,
           away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
           away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
           away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal - away_team_goal >= 5
),
away_lineup AS (
    SELECT season, away_player_1 AS player_id FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_2 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_3 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_4 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_5 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_6 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_7 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_8 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_9 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_10 FROM heavy_loss
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_11 FROM heavy_loss
)
SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS different_players
FROM away_lineup
WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.name AS country_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_api_id) AS player_count
    FROM appearances a
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = a.country_id
    WHERE p.weight >= 210
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT country_name, player_count
FROM counts
WHERE player_count = (SELECT MAX(player_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY country_name;

WITH lineup AS (
    SELECT
        "Match".season,
        v.value AS player_id
    FROM "Match"
    JOIN League ON League.id = "Match".league_id
    JOIN Country ON Country.id = League.country_id
    JOIN json_each(json_array(
        "Match".home_player_1, "Match".home_player_2, "Match".home_player_3,
        "Match".home_player_4, "Match".home_player_5, "Match".home_player_6,
        "Match".home_player_7, "Match".home_player_8, "Match".home_player_9,
        "Match".home_player_10, "Match".home_player_11,
        "Match".away_player_1, "Match".away_player_2, "Match".away_player_3,
        "Match".away_player_4, "Match".away_player_5, "Match".away_player_6,
        "Match".away_player_7, "Match".away_player_8, "Match".away_player_9,
        "Match".away_player_10, "Match".away_player_11
    )) AS v
    WHERE Country.name = 'Italy'
      AND "Match".season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
      AND v.value IS NOT NULL
),
distinct_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT season, player_id
    FROM lineup
)
SELECT
    season,
    COUNT(*) AS player_count,
    ROUND(AVG(Player.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM distinct_players
JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id = distinct_players.player_id
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        volleys,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_ratings AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT home_player_3 AS player_id,
         SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
  FROM "Match"
  WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY home_player_3
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals
FROM player_totals;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT m.country_id, m.id AS match_id, p.player_id
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN (
        SELECT id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"

country_counts AS (
    SELECT c.id AS country_id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS player_match_count
    FROM match_players AS mp
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_id
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = mp.country_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM country_counts
WHERE player_match_count = (SELECT MIN(player_match_count) FROM country_counts);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2015-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium');

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(attacking_work_rate)) = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND LOWER(TRIM(preferred_foot)) = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> '';

    SELECT id AS match_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'

    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'

    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'

match_counts AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_appearances
    WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, COALESCE(mc.matches_played, 0) AS matches_played
FROM Player AS p
LEFT JOIN match_counts AS mc ON mc.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday > '1990-12-31'
ORDER BY p.player_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date <= '2007-08-30'
  AND jumping >= 80;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Match AS m
  ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
  AND m.season = '2012/2013'
  AND m.date = (
    SELECT MAX(m2.date)
    FROM Match AS m2
    WHERE m2.season = '2012/2013'
      AND (m2.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
        OR m2.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
  )
  AND ta.date = (
    SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
    FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
    WHERE ta2.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
      AND ta2.date <= m.date
  )
LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2013-07-12 00:00:00'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN player_api_id = 30700 THEN overall_rating END) - AVG(overall_rating))
    * 100.0 / AVG(overall_rating),
    2
)
FROM ratings;

WITH lowest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A12 = (SELECT MIN(A12) FROM district)
),
oldest_female_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM lowest_salary_district)
      AND birth_date = (
          SELECT MIN(c.birth_date)
          FROM client c
          WHERE c.gender = 'F'
            AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM lowest_salary_district)
      )
)
SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A12) - MIN(A12) FROM district) AS salary_difference
FROM oldest_female_clients o
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = o.client_id;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS male_percentage
FROM client AS c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT 100.0 * (t2.balance - t1.balance) / t1.balance AS percentage_increase
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t1
  ON t1.account_id = l.account_id
 AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t2
  ON t2.account_id = l.account_id
 AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2001-01-01'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.A2 AS district,
    ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan AS l
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
  AND d.A12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.A13 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY district;

SELECT d.type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count
FROM disp AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND dist.A11 > 8000
  AND dist.A11 <= 9000
GROUP BY d.type;

WITH male_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN male_accounts AS ma ON ma.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND l.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    100.0 * (
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1997 THEN total_amount END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1996 THEN total_amount END)
    ) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1996 THEN total_amount END) AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_totals;

SELECT frequency AS statement_frequency,
       k_symbol AS payment_purpose_code
FROM account
JOIN `order` USING (account_id)
WHERE account_id = 3
  AND amount = 3539;

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS month
    FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN first_month AS f
      ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.month
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN opened_districts AS o
      ON o.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district, population
FROM candidates
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM candidates);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = t.account_id
 AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

WITH top_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
per_account AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_loan_amount
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
district_averages AS (
    SELECT
        td.district_id,
        td.district_name,
        ROUND(1.0 * SUM(pa.active_loan_amount) / COUNT(*)) AS average_active_loan_per_account
    FROM top_districts AS td
    JOIN per_account AS pa ON pa.district_id = td.district_id
    GROUP BY td.district_id, td.district_name
)
SELECT district_name, average_active_loan_per_account
FROM district_averages
WHERE average_active_loan_per_account = (
    SELECT MAX(average_active_loan_per_account)
    FROM district_averages
);

WITH regional_totals AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_approved_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE date(l.date) <= date('1995-12-31')
      AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months') >= date('1995-12-31')
    GROUP BY d.A2
)
SELECT region, total_approved_amount
FROM regional_totals
WHERE total_approved_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_approved_amount) FROM regional_totals);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT branch_district.district_id
    FROM district AS branch_district
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = branch_district.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE branch_district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_average_salary,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
