FROM qualifying_districts AS q
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = q.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT c.district_id, AVG(d.A11) AS district_avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp owner_disp
          WHERE owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
            AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM disp any_disp
                JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = any_disp.disp_id
                WHERE any_disp.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
            )
      )
    GROUP BY c.district_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS d
        ON d.account_id = a.account_id
       AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
);

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.trans_id END) AS household_payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '' THEN t.trans_id END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND t.amount > 4000;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS outside_counterparty_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
      AND bank IS NOT NULL
      AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
),
borrowing_households AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS account_opening_date,
        lt.total_amount_borrowed,
        COALESCE(cc.outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_counterparty_count,
        d.A2 AS home_district,
        d.A8 AS district_population
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan_totals AS lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
                   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district
        WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice'
    )
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    account_opening_date,
    total_amount_borrowed,
    outside_counterparty_count,
    home_district,
    district_population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY district_population DESC
    ) AS population_rank
FROM borrowing_households
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id;

WITH account_avg AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, d.district_id
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS dp
      ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN account_avg AS aa
      ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
      AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT q.gender,
           COUNT(*) AS district_count,
           MAX(CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER)) AS max_inhabitants,
           ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(d.A10), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM qualifying_districts AS q
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY q.gender
)
SELECT s.gender,
       s.district_count,
       d.A2 AS district,
       CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM district_stats AS s
JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
  ON q.gender = s.gender
JOIN district AS d
  ON d.district_id = q.district_id
WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = s.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         d.A2;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district AS x ON x.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'gold'
      AND CAST(x.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank,
        t.account,
        COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payments,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN eligible_accounts AS e ON e.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
)
SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount
FROM pair_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM pair_totals);

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount),
    2
)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 18
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '';

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.district_id,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A13 AS unemployment_1996,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A8 AS inhabitants
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
       AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan AS l
          WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
      )
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        district_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
        ) AS district_rank
    FROM eligible_districts
)
SELECT
    e.region,
    ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS average_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(e.unemployment_1996), 2) AS average_1996_district_unemployment_rate,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.district_rank = 1 THEN r.district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM eligible_districts AS e
JOIN ranked_districts AS r
    ON r.region = e.region
   AND r.district_name = e.district_name
GROUP BY e.region
ORDER BY e.region;

WITH district_crimes AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name COLLATE NOCASE
        ) AS district_rank
    FROM district_crimes
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) AS overall_average
    FROM district_crimes
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    crimes_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996) OVER (), 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND((SELECT overall_average FROM averages), 2) AS overall_district_average,
    ROUND(
        AVG(crimes_1996) OVER () - (SELECT overall_average FROM averages),
        2
    ) AS difference
FROM ranked_districts
WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'
  AND district_rank <= 3
ORDER BY district_rank;

WITH markets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.type,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district,
        d.A8 AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS p ON p.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = p.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
)
SELECT type, district, inhabitants
FROM (
    SELECT
        type,
        district,
        inhabitants,
        MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY type) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM markets
)
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY type, district;

WITH region AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region_name
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
selected_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = (SELECT region_name FROM region)
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.account_id
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN selected_accounts AS sa ON sa.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT sa.account_id, sa.district_id, rt.balance
    FROM selected_accounts AS sa
    JOIN ranked_transactions AS rt
      ON rt.account_id = sa.account_id
     AND rt.rn = 1
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
        ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM account_balances AS ab
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    accounts_opened,
    avg_balance,
    NULL AS region_avg_balance,
    NULL AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2),
    NULL
FROM account_balances

UNION ALL

SELECT
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    district_name
FROM district_stats
ORDER BY district_name;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount,
        a.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
selected_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE loan_rank <= 10
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM selected_districts AS sd
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = sd.district_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT district_id FROM district_stats ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS district_id,
    (SELECT inhabitants FROM district_stats ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM district_stats;

WITH account_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
withdrawals AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_orders AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        w.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        COALESCE(s.total_standing_order_debit, 0) * 1.0 / ac.account_count AS avg_standing_order_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawals AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN account_counts AS ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN standing_orders AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(avg_standing_order_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM metrics
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC;

WITH client_access AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
transaction_summary AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A4 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A4
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A4 AS region,
        A2 AS district_name,
        A8 AS inhabitants,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A4 ORDER BY A8 DESC) AS population_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(A2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A4 ORDER BY A8 DESC, district_id
        ) AS most_populous_district,
        FIRST_VALUE(A8) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A4 ORDER BY A8 DESC, district_id
        ) AS most_populous_inhabitants
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS date_opened,
    a.frequency,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region,
    CASE WHEN d.district_id = home.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    COALESCE(rcc.client_count, 0) AS clients_in_region,
    rd.most_populous_district,
    rd.most_populous_inhabitants,
    rd.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM client_access ca
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client home ON home.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ts.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = d.A4
JOIN ranked_districts rd ON rd.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH account_loans AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.district_id,
           a.date,
           COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS amount_lent
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.district_id IN (
          SELECT district_id
          FROM district
          WHERE A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      )
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date
),
district_year AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', date) AS creation_year,
           district_id,
           SUM(amount_lent) AS district_amount_lent,
           COUNT(*) AS district_accounts
    FROM account_loans
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date), district_id
)
SELECT creation_year,
       SUM(district_accounts) AS account_count,
       SUM(district_amount_lent) AS total_amount_lent,
       ROUND(AVG(1.0 * district_amount_lent / district_accounts), 2)
           AS average_district_amount_lent_per_account
FROM district_year
GROUP BY creation_year
ORDER BY creation_year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.date,
        l.amount,
        d.A2 AS district,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT
    r.district,
    r.amount AS approved_amount,
    r.date AS approval_date,
    (
        SELECT t.balance
        FROM trans AS t
        WHERE t.account_id = r.account_id
          AND t.date <= r.date
        ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS balance
FROM ranked_loans AS r
WHERE r.rn <= 10
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.date ASC, r.loan_id ASC;

WITH client_loans AS (
    SELECT
        dp.client_id,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM disp dp
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = dp.account_id
    GROUP BY dp.client_id
),
card_clients AS (
    SELECT
        cl.client_id,
        cl.gender,
        cl.birth_date,
        ca.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', ca.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
        COALESCE(lo.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(lo.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(lo.number_of_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower'
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', ca.issued) AS INTEGER)
                 - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 30
                THEN 'Young borrower'
            ELSE 'Mature borrower'
        END AS borrower_classification,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS district_average_salary
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    LEFT JOIN client_loans lo ON lo.client_id = cl.client_id
    WHERE ca.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND ca.issued < '1995-01-01'
)
SELECT
    client_id,
    gender,
    birth_date,
    card_type,
    age_at_issue,
    number_of_loans,
    total_amount_borrowed,
    borrower_classification,
    district_name,
    district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM card_clients
ORDER BY client_id;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NULL
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    t.bank AS bank_code,
    t.account AS account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_outgoing_payments,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1996-01-03'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -t.amount END) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.account_id = 2335
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND t.k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH loan_region AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        branch.A2 AS branch_district,
        branch.A3 AS region
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
regional_loans AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
regional_salary AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
),
deposits AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    WHERE type = 'PRIJEM'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT loan_region.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM loan_region
)
SELECT
    ranked.client_id,
    ranked.amount AS loan_amount,
    ranked.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(ranked.payments * ranked.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(ranked.payments * ranked.duration - ranked.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    ranked.status AS loan_status,
    ranked.branch_district,
    ranked.region,
    COALESCE(deposits.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(deposits.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(deposits.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * ranked.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(deposits.total_deposits, 0) > ranked.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    regional_loans.loan_count,
    regional_salary.avg_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', ranked.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', ranked.birth_date) > '10-09' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM ranked
LEFT JOIN deposits ON deposits.account_id = ranked.account_id
JOIN regional_loans ON regional_loans.region = ranked.region
JOIN regional_salary ON regional_salary.region = ranked.region
WHERE ranked.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY ranked.amount DESC, ranked.loan_id, ranked.client_id;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region_name,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND l.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3, d.A4
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT
        region_name,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        SUM(population) AS combined_population,
        SUM(account_count) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT
    region_name,
    district_count,
    combined_population,
    account_count
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 AS salary, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM district d
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A11
)
SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total_monthly_statement_accounts,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count,
       ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
                 AND bank IS NOT NULL
                 AND account IS NOT NULL
            THEN bank || ':' || account
        END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_details AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        district.A2 AS district_name,
        district.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
    JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    number_of_loans,
    external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM account_details
ORDER BY rank, account_id;

WITH
branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           CASE
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT b.account_id,
           b.opened_date,
           o.gender,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', o.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
             - CASE
                   WHEN strftime('%m-%d', o.birth_date) > '12-31' THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END AS age,
           COALESCE(c.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
           COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           CASE WHEN l.loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan' ELSE l.loan_standing END AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(a.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(a.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(a.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(a.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM branch_accounts b
    JOIN owner_info o ON o.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened_date,
       gender,
       age,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       transaction_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH classic_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT coa.client_id) AS classic_card_holding_clients,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN t.bank || ':' || t.account
        END) AS external_accounts,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN classic_owner_accounts AS coa ON coa.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(dm.classic_card_holding_clients, 0) AS classic_card_holding_clients,
    COALESCE(dm.external_accounts, 0) AS external_accounts,
    COALESCE(dm.total_outgoing_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_metrics AS dm ON dm.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
) AS qualifying_districts
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = qualifying_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date < '1950-01-01'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A10), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
) AS loan_districts
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = loan_districts.district_id;

WITH cohort_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort'
            WHEN c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31' THEN 'old cohort'
        END AS cohort,
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01'
       OR c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31'
)
SELECT
    cohort,
    ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_salary
FROM cohort_accounts AS ca
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ca.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(
    (CAST(r853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL))
    * 100.0 / CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM results AS r853
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r853.driverId
JOIN results AS r854 ON r854.driverId = r853.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r853.raceId = 853
  AND r854.raceId = 854;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position <> 1 OR r.position IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_not_victories
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

WITH winner_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
max_wins AS (
    SELECT MAX(wins) AS wins
    FROM winner_counts
),
driver_points AS (
    SELECT driverId, MAX(points) AS highest_points
    FROM driverStandings
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, dp.highest_points
FROM winner_counts AS wc
JOIN max_wins AS mw ON wc.wins = mw.wins
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = wc.driverId
LEFT JOIN driver_points AS dp ON dp.driverId = wc.driverId;

WITH race_results AS (
    SELECT res.milliseconds, res.laps, res.positionOrder
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 1988
      AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
full_distance AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM race_results
    WHERE laps = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM race_results)
),
last_full_distance AS (
    SELECT milliseconds
    FROM full_distance
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
winner AS (
    SELECT milliseconds
    FROM race_results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (last_full_distance.milliseconds - winner.milliseconds) * 100.0
    / last_full_distance.milliseconds,
    2
) AS percentage_shorter
FROM winner
CROSS JOIN last_full_distance;

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT raceId, laps
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN entry.laps = winner.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM results AS entry
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = entry.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = entry.raceId
JOIN winners AS winner ON winner.raceId = entry.raceId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT
    r.year,
    ROUND(AVG(res.milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) AS mean_winner_elapsed_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res
    ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND res.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS score
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE ci.name = 'Circuit de Monaco'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lt.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    printf(
        '%d:%02d.%03d',
        MIN(l.milliseconds) / 60000,
        (MIN(l.milliseconds) / 1000) % 60,
        MIN(l.milliseconds) % 1000
    ) AS fastest_lap
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes AS l ON l.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

WITH hosted_2000 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT circuitId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2000
),
race_stops AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stop_count
    FROM races AS r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.circuitId NOT IN (SELECT circuitId FROM hosted_2000)
    GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2)
FROM race_stops;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q1) <> ''
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q2.q1) <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MAX(q1)
      FROM qualifying
      WHERE raceId = r.raceId
        AND q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q1) <> ''
  );

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q_other.driverId) AS drivers_outqualified
FROM qualifying AS q_lucas
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q_lucas.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q_lucas.driverId
JOIN qualifying AS q_other ON q_other.raceId = q_lucas.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2010
  AND d.forename = 'Lucas'
  AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
  AND q_lucas.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q_other.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q_lucas.position < q_other.position;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 <> '\N'
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
    CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
    CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
  ) = (
    SELECT MIN(
      CAST(substr(q2, 1, instr(q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
      CAST(substr(q2, instr(q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
      CAST(substr(q2, instr(q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
    )
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = q2.raceId
    WHERE r2.year = 2017
      AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q2.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q2.q2 <> ''
      AND q2.q2 <> '\N'
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS runners_up
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND res.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) >= 2
ORDER BY runners_up DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    time(
        r.time,
        printf('+%d seconds', res.milliseconds / 1000),
        printf('+%d milliseconds', res.milliseconds % 1000)
    ) || '.' || printf('%03d', res.milliseconds % 1000) AS finish_local_time,
    d.url
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR q.q3 = '');

SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 < '1:40.000';

SELECT c.name, c.location, c.country, r.year, p.duration
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops);

SELECT ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.q3) <> '' THEN 1 END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId),
    2
) AS average_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1992-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.code IS NULL OR d.code = '')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM drivers AS other
      WHERE other.forename = d.forename
        AND other.driverId <> d.driverId
  )
  AND (
      CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, -3) AS REAL) / 1000.0
  ) > 120;

SELECT d.driverRef AS reference_name,
       SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lapTimes AS lt
      WHERE lt.driverId = r.driverId
        AND lt.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef;

WITH driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
)
SELECT
    r.date,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    CASE
        WHEN f.fastest_ms IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE printf('%d:%02d.%03d',
                    f.fastest_ms / 60000,
                    (f.fastest_ms / 1000) % 60,
                    f.fastest_ms % 1000)
    END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM races AS r
LEFT JOIN driver_fastest_laps AS f
    ON f.raceId = r.raceId
   AND f.fastest_ms > 90000
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d
    ON d.driverId = f.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
  AND r.year >= 1990
ORDER BY r.date, d.surname, d.forename;

WITH italian_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        q.q3,
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS millis
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(millis) AS millis
    FROM italian_q3
)
SELECT DISTINCT i.forename, i.surname, i.q3
FROM italian_q3 AS i
JOIN fastest AS f ON f.millis = i.millis;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.year AS race_year,
        q.q3 AS q3_time,
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
            + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND CAST(substr(d.dob, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1980
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
      AND q.q3 <> '\N'
)
SELECT driver_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM eligible
WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM eligible);

WITH driver_race_best AS (
  SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_ms
  FROM lapTimes
  GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         driverId,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY best_ms) AS lap_rank
  FROM driver_race_best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.lap_rank = 2
  AND d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3
LIMIT 1;

WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr
        ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
    LEFT JOIN races AS r
        ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS career_rank
    FROM constructor_points
)
SELECT name, career_points, url
FROM ranked
WHERE career_rank <= 3
ORDER BY career_points DESC, name;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY d.forename;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
    + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 4, 3) AS INTEGER)
  ) = (
    SELECT MIN(
      CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 4, 3) AS INTEGER)
    )
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q3) <> ''
  );

SELECT
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN c.constructorId END) AS constructor_count
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

WITH years AS (
    SELECT year
    FROM races
    WHERE year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
    GROUP BY year
),
eligible_races AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
      AND d.nationality = 'Australian'
      AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
)
SELECT y.year, COUNT(ps.raceId) AS total_pit_stops
FROM years AS y
LEFT JOIN eligible_races AS er ON er.year = y.year
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps ON ps.raceId = er.raceId
GROUP BY y.year
ORDER BY y.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) > 120;

WITH september_pit_stops AS (
    SELECT p.raceId, p.driverId, p.duration, p.milliseconds
    FROM pitStops AS p
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
    WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01'
      AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS milliseconds
    FROM september_pit_stops
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
       p.duration AS pit_stop_time,
       r.name AS race,
       c.name AS circuit,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM september_pit_stops AS p
JOIN fastest AS f ON p.milliseconds = f.milliseconds
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, d.dob
    FROM drivers AS d
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM results AS r
        WHERE r.driverId = d.driverId
          AND r.position = 1
    )
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY dob ASC, (forename || ' ' || surname) COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT ra.name, ra.date
    FROM results AS r
    JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM chosen)
      AND r.position = 1
    ORDER BY ra.date ASC, ra.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.forename || ' ' || c.surname AS full_name,
    c.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_win_race,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM results AS r
        JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE r.driverId = c.driverId
    ) AS races_started
FROM chosen AS c
CROSS JOIN first_win AS fw;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId)
FROM results AS r
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = r.statusId
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        q.constructorId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY q.q2, res.grid
        ) AS rn
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r
        ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    LEFT JOIN results AS res
        ON res.raceId = q.raceId
       AND res.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor
FROM ranked AS x
JOIN drivers AS d
    ON d.driverId = x.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c
    ON c.constructorId = x.constructorId
WHERE x.rn = 2;

WITH timed AS (
    SELECT
        q.q2,
        d.surname,
        r.name,
        CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
            + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q2) <> ''
)
SELECT surname, name
FROM timed
WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM timed);

SELECT d.number
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.code AS driver_code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      JOIN races AS r2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId
      WHERE r2.year = 2017
        AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT r.year AS season_year,
       runner.milliseconds - winner.milliseconds AS runner_up_gap_milliseconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS winner
  ON winner.raceId = r.raceId AND winner.positionOrder = 1
JOIN results AS runner
  ON runner.raceId = r.raceId AND runner.positionOrder = 2
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.time = (
      SELECT MIN(time)
      FROM races
      WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
        AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
        AND time IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, res.time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time <= '17:00:00'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT d.number, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND (
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      ) < 98.000;

WITH race_times AS (
    SELECT c.circuitRef, r.time
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(time) AS earliest_time, MAX(time) AS latest_time
    FROM race_times
)
SELECT
    (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
     FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
         FROM race_times, bounds
         WHERE time = earliest_time
         ORDER BY circuitRef
     )) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
     FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
         FROM race_times, bounds
         WHERE time = latest_time
         ORDER BY circuitRef
     )) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    (
        CAST(substr(latest_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
        + CAST(substr(latest_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(latest_time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(substr(earliest_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
        - CAST(substr(earliest_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
        - CAST(substr(earliest_time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER)
    ) AS gap_seconds
FROM bounds;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
  AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) <> ''
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) DESC,
         d.dob ASC,
         d.surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (q.q2 IS NULL OR q.q2 = '')
ORDER BY
  CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) DESC,
  q.driverId ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS withdrawn_drivers
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL THEN r.driverId END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 1957
  AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total), 2) AS mean_total_expense_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT e.link_to_budget, SUM(e.cost) AS event_total
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', e.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY e.link_to_budget
);

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_amount_difference
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE date_received = '2019-09-14'
  AND source = 'Fundraising';

SELECT
  (SELECT b.amount
   FROM budget AS b
   JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
   WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
     AND b.category = 'Advertisement') * 1.0
  / (SELECT b.amount
     FROM budget AS b
     JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
     WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting'
       AND b.category = 'Advertisement') AS ratio;

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
highest_ratio AS (
    SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT event_ratios.event_name
FROM event_ratios
JOIN highest_ratio
    ON event_ratios.spending_ratio = highest_ratio.spending_ratio;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) > 7;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
WHERE m.member_id IN (
    SELECT e.link_to_member
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
);

WITH fall_events AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE date(event_date) BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
),
event_counts AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS head_count
    FROM fall_events e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
target AS (
    SELECT head_count
    FROM event_counts
    WHERE event_id = (
        SELECT event_id
        FROM event
        WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
    )
),
average AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(head_count), 1) AS average_attendance
    FROM event_counts
)
SELECT
    target.head_count AS womens_soccer_attendees,
    average.average_attendance AS average_fall_2019_attendees,
    CASE
        WHEN target.head_count > average.average_attendance THEN 'more'
        WHEN target.head_count < average.average_attendance THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
FROM target
CROSS JOIN average;

WITH department_majors AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        major_id,
        major_name
    FROM major
    WHERE department IN (
        SELECT department
        FROM major
        WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
    )
),
major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        dm.major_id,
        dm.major_name,
        COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM department_majors AS dm
    LEFT JOIN member AS m
        ON m.link_to_major = dm.major_id
    GROUP BY dm.department, dm.major_id, dm.major_name
)
SELECT
    department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        CASE WHEN member_count > 0 THEN major_name END,
        ', '
    ) AS majors_held_by_members,
    ROUND(SUM(member_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major_member_counts
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department_name;

WITH events_2019 AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
),
budget_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT a.type AS event_type,
       a.members_attended,
       COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget_dollars
FROM attendance_by_type AS a
LEFT JOIN budget_by_type AS b ON b.type = a.type
ORDER BY a.type;

SELECT
    ma.department,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues
FROM major AS ma
LEFT JOIN member AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
   AND m.position = 'Member'
LEFT JOIN income AS i
    ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
   AND i.source = 'Dues'
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM attendance AS a
       WHERE a.link_to_member = m.member_id
   )
WHERE ma.college = 'College of Engineering'
GROUP BY ma.department
ORDER BY ma.department;

WITH qualifying_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
member_budget_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.link_to_member, e.link_to_budget
    FROM expense e
    JOIN qualifying_members q ON q.link_to_member = e.link_to_member
    WHERE e.link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(b.amount, 0) - COALESCE(b.spent, 0)), 2) AS total_remaining
FROM qualifying_members q
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member
JOIN member_budget_lines mb ON mb.link_to_member = q.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = mb.link_to_budget
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_remaining DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

SELECT SUM(i.amount)
FROM attendance AS a
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN income AS i ON i.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  AND i.source = 'Dues';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM major AS m
WHERE m.college = (
    SELECT m2.college
    FROM major AS m2
    JOIN member AS u ON u.link_to_major = m2.major_id
    WHERE u.first_name = 'Tyler'
      AND u.last_name = 'Hewitt'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM member AS enrolled
    WHERE enrolled.link_to_major = m.major_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
        FROM budget
        WHERE LOWER(category) = 'advertisement'
    ) AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
);

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_name;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.major_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    JOIN member AS mb
        ON mb.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS m
        ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.major_name
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM major_counts
WHERE attendee_count = (SELECT MAX(attendee_count) FROM major_counts)
ORDER BY major_name;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer'
    ELSE 'other student'
  END AS member_group,
  ROUND(AVG(event_count), 2) AS average_events_attended
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.position,
    COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS event_count
  FROM member AS m
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
)
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer'
    ELSE 'other student'
  END;

WITH RECURSIVE item_kinds(budget_id, rest, kind) AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id, x.expense_description || ',', ''
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE b.remaining < 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT budget_id,
           substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1),
           trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1))
    FROM item_kinds
    WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(kind))
FROM item_kinds
WHERE kind <> '';

WITH attendee_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_spending AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event,
           SUM(ex.cost) AS water_spend
    FROM budget b
    JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE lower(ex.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT e.event_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ws.water_spend, 0) / ac.attendee_count, 2) AS amount_per_attendee
FROM event e
JOIN attendee_counts ac ON ac.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_spending ws ON ws.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS members_in_college,
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS members_not_in_college
FROM member
LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

WITH chip_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id
    FROM expense x
    JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
),
event_max AS (
    SELECT ce.event_id, MAX(b.amount) AS max_line_amount
    FROM chip_events ce
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = ce.event_id
    GROUP BY ce.event_id
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event_max em
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = em.event_id
WHERE em.max_line_amount = (SELECT MAX(max_line_amount) FROM event_max)
ORDER BY e.event_name;

SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS date, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'
  AND e.expense_date = (
    SELECT MAX(e2.expense_date)
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN member m2 ON m2.member_id = e2.link_to_member
    WHERE m2.position = 'Vice President'
  );

SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT ma.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.major_id) AS number_of_majors
    FROM member AS m
    JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major
    GROUP BY ma.college
)
SELECT college, number_of_majors
FROM college_counts
WHERE number_of_majors = (SELECT MAX(number_of_majors) FROM college_counts)
ORDER BY college;

SELECT e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT x.expense_description) AS different_things_bought
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.amount > 40
GROUP BY e.location;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE date(e.event_date) BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM expense AS x
      JOIN budget AS xb ON xb.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
      WHERE xb.link_to_event = e.event_id
        AND x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  );

SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_spent_per_event
FROM event;

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budget,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spending
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN x.expense_id IS NULL THEN 0
                    ELSE 1 + length(x.expense_description)
                             - length(replace(x.expense_description, ',', ''))
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS purchase_count
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
)
SELECT t.event_name
FROM event_totals AS t
JOIN purchase_counts AS p ON p.event_id = t.event_id
WHERE t.total_spending <= t.total_budget
ORDER BY p.purchase_count DESC, t.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH type_counts AS (
    SELECT
        e.type AS event_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE date(e.event_date) >= '2019-09-01'
      AND date(e.event_date) < '2020-06-01'
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT event_type, member_count
FROM type_counts
WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM type_counts);

SELECT e.expense_description, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, e.expense_description ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RECURSIVE items(expense_id, category, cost, remaining, item) AS (
    SELECT e.expense_id,
           b.category,
           e.cost,
           e.expense_description || ',',
           ''
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event AS v ON b.link_to_event = v.event_id
    WHERE v.event_name = 'October Meeting'
      AND e.approved = 'true'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT expense_id,
           category,
           cost,
           substr(remaining, instr(remaining, ',') + 1),
           trim(substr(remaining, 1, instr(remaining, ',') - 1))
    FROM items
    WHERE remaining <> ''
)
SELECT item AS item_name,
       category,
       SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM items
WHERE item <> ''
GROUP BY category, item
ORDER BY category, item_name;

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount)
     FROM budget AS b
     WHERE b.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS total_budgeted,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member)
     FROM attendance AS a
     WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS members_attended
FROM event AS e
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m
  ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

WITH items AS (
    SELECT
        e.link_to_member,
        trim(j.value) AS item
    FROM expense AS e,
         json_each('["' || replace(e.expense_description, ', ', '","') || '"]') AS j
    WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
kinds AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT lower(item)) AS kind_count
    FROM items
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
spending AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, MAX(kind_count) OVER () AS max_kinds
    FROM kinds
)
SELECT
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    r.kind_count AS different_kinds,
    s.total_spending
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = r.link_to_member
JOIN spending AS s ON s.link_to_member = r.link_to_member
WHERE r.kind_count = r.max_kinds;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.major_name) AS different_majors
FROM member AS mem
JOIN major AS m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE m.department = 'Political Science Department';

SELECT
    c.colour,
    COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p
    ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS c
    ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND c.colour IS NOT NULL
  AND c.colour <> ''
  AND c.colour <> 'No Colour'
GROUP BY c.id, c.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, c.colour ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT h.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
ORDER BY h.superhero_name;

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id;

SELECT
    (SELECT publisher_name
     FROM publisher
     WHERE publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
     ORDER BY (
         SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM superhero
         WHERE publisher_id = publisher.id
     ) DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS publisher,
    ABS(
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM superhero
         WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'))
        -
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM superhero
         WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'))
    ) AS difference;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE lower(a.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE lower(a2.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(s.full_name) <> ''
ORDER BY s.full_name;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN colour AS skin ON skin.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE eye.colour = hair.colour
  AND hair.colour = skin.colour
  AND eye.colour <> 'No Colour';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.publisher_name,
        COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
    FROM publisher AS p
    LEFT JOIN superhero AS s
        ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p.publisher_name
)
SELECT CASE
           WHEN dc.superhero_count = marvel.superhero_count THEN 'Tie'
           WHEN dc.superhero_count > marvel.superhero_count
               THEN 'DC Comics by ' || (dc.superhero_count - marvel.superhero_count)
           ELSE 'Marvel Comics by ' || (marvel.superhero_count - dc.superhero_count)
       END AS result
FROM counts AS dc
CROSS JOIN counts AS marvel
WHERE dc.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND marvel.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

WITH dc_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power AS hp
  JOIN superhero AS h ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
marvel_characters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.id, h.height_cm
  FROM superhero AS h
  JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
  JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dc_powers AS d
      WHERE d.power_id = hp.power_id
    )
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm)
FROM marvel_characters;

WITH strength_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
),
strength_only_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN strength_heroes sh ON sh.hero_id = hp.hero_id
    EXCEPT
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM strength_only_powers;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) NOT IN ('good', 'bad')
   OR a.alignment IS NULL;

SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'
GROUP BY sp.id, sp.power_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) = (
    SELECT MAX(power_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.id) AS power_count
        FROM superhero AS s2
        JOIN publisher AS p2 ON p2.id = s2.publisher_id
        JOIN hero_power AS hp2 ON hp2.hero_id = s2.id
        WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
          AND s2.full_name IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(s2.full_name) <> ''
          AND TRIM(s2.full_name) <> '-'
        GROUP BY hp2.power_id
    )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha2.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS s2
      JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
        AND a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

SELECT g.gender, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND c.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hp.power_count >= 10
GROUP BY g.gender
ORDER BY CASE g.gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 1 WHEN 'Female' THEN 2 END;

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT hha.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS h
      JOIN hero_attribute AS hha ON hha.hero_id = h.id
      JOIN attribute AS ha_attr ON ha_attr.id = hha.attribute_id
      WHERE h.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
        AND ha_attr.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM superhero
),
tallest AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM ranked
    WHERE height_rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM tallest AS t
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = t.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE r.race IN ('God / Eternal', 'Eternal')
      AND g.gender = 'Male'
    GROUP BY s.id
);

WITH cryo_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE power_id = 19
),
related_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power AS hp
  JOIN hero_power AS holder_power
    ON holder_power.power_id = hp.power_id
  JOIN cryo_holders AS ch
    ON ch.hero_id = holder_power.hero_id
),
hero_counts AS (
  SELECT rh.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM related_heroes AS rh
  JOIN hero_power AS hp
    ON hp.hero_id = rh.hero_id
  GROUP BY rh.hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1)
FROM hero_counts;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(dc.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS dc
JOIN publisher AS dp ON dp.id = dc.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = dc.eye_colour_id
WHERE dp.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND dc.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS marvel
    JOIN publisher AS mp ON mp.id = marvel.publisher_id
