    JOIN colour AS marvel_eye ON marvel_eye.id = marvel.eye_colour_id
    WHERE mp.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND marvel_eye.colour = eye.colour
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

WITH eligible_races AS (
    SELECT s.race_id
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    WHERE s.race_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.race_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN eligible_races AS er ON er.race_id = s.race_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT publisher_id) AS publisher_count
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm > 200
  AND publisher_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND (s.publisher_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM publisher AS p
    WHERE p.id = s.publisher_id
      AND p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  ));

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg,
       COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE lower(superhero_name) = 'blackwulf'
)
AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS other
    WHERE other.eye_colour_id = h.eye_colour_id
      AND other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND other.publisher_id <> h.publisher_id
);

SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
  AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.id, r.race
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(race_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count
        FROM superhero
        WHERE publisher_id = (
            SELECT publisher_id
            FROM superhero
            WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
        )
          AND race_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY race_id
    )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero
WHERE gender_id = 2
  AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(ha.attribute_value AS REAL)), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE sp.power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')
  );

WITH hero_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        g.gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND TRIM(COALESCE(s.full_name, '')) NOT IN ('', '-')
      AND instr(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
    GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
)
SELECT
    gender,
    ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers
FROM hero_counts
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm), 2) AS average_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(s.height_cm, 0)), 1) AS average_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(s.weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.id <> (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
)
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND hp.power_id IN (
            SELECT hp3.power_id
            FROM hero_power AS hp3
            WHERE hp3.hero_id = (
                SELECT id
                FROM superhero
                WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
            )
        )
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg < 70
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm = (
    SELECT MIN(height_cm)
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
);

WITH lightest_weight AS (
    SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN lightest_weight AS lw ON h.weight_kg = lw.weight_kg
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
    GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count)
FROM hero_power_counts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON alignment.id = superhero.alignment_id
WHERE alignment.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(full_name) <> '-';

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-');

SELECT eye_colour, hero_count
FROM (
    SELECT eye.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS hero
    JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = hero.eye_colour_id
    WHERE hero.eye_colour_id IN (
        SELECT brown_hero.eye_colour_id
        FROM superhero AS brown_hero
        JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = brown_hero.hair_colour_id
        WHERE hair.colour = 'Brown'
    )
      AND (hero.hair_colour_id IS NULL OR hero.hair_colour_id NOT IN (
          SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Brown'
      ))
    GROUP BY eye.colour
)
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

WITH target_powers AS (
    SELECT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
),
qualifying_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN target_powers AS tp ON tp.power_id = hp.power_id
    WHERE hp.hero_id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM qualifying_heroes AS q
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = q.hero_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL
  AND c.colour IN ('No Colour', 'Blue');

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM qualifying_patients;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(L.ALB), 4) AS avg_alb
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.PLT > 400
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND date(p.Birthday, '+50 years') < date('2026-10-09');

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GLU >= 180
      AND l.`T-CHO` < 250
);

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    2
) AS female_percentage
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-56 years')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PT >= 14
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP LIKE '%+%'
  AND (p.Description IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(p.Description AS TEXT)) = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID), 2) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1941-01-01';

WITH strongest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    )
),
highest AS (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) AS bilirubin
    FROM strongest
)
SELECT L.`T-BIL`, L.Date, L.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM strongest AS L
JOIN highest AS H ON L.`T-BIL` = H.bilirubin
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0', '')
),
patient_titers AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS rnp_titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) NOT IN ('negative', '')
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT ID, rnp_titer
FROM patient_titers
WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM patient_titers);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS NUMERIC) > 5
  );

WITH lab_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(DISTINCT Date) AS lab_dates
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.SEX, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.lab_dates, 0)), 2) AS average_lab_dates
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN lab_counts AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.Date, l.DNA
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory AS l2
      JOIN Patient AS p2 ON p2.ID = l2.ID
      WHERE p2.SEX = 'F'
        AND p2.Admission = '+'
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(l2.DNA) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.Admission AS care_setting, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
  )
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY p.Admission;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
);

SELECT MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_rnp_value
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l.PLT > 100
          AND l.PLT < 400
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l.PLT > 100
          AND l.PLT < 400
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_never_with_normal_platelet
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
        AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Birthday >= '1960-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE lower(Diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis'
  AND Birthday IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`U-PRO` IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
  );

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 32
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT MIN(
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
  );

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM Laboratory l
     JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
     WHERE lower(p.Diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis') AS total_laboratory_tests,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM Patient p
     WHERE lower(p.Diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis'
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory l
           WHERE l.ID = p.ID
       )) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE date(e."Examination Date") BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0;

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' OR Diagnosis LIKE 'SLE+%' THEN ID
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT ID),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis > 0;

WITH first_examination AS (
    SELECT ID, MIN("Examination Date") AS examination_date
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(e.examination_date) - julianday(p."First Date"))) AS average_delay_days
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN first_examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND instr(p.Admission, '+') > 0
  AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.Date <= '1994-12-31'
  AND l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 600
  AND l.LDH < 800
  AND (
      CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
      OR l."U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000')
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
      AND l.UN < 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
     - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END)
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = q.ID;

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_out_of_range,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_patients,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
        1
    ) AS share_percent
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH patient_maxima AS (
    SELECT
        p.Admission,
        l.ID,
        MAX(l."T-CHO") AS reading
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
      AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.Admission, l.ID
),
group_maxima AS (
    SELECT Admission, MAX(reading) AS highest_reading
    FROM patient_maxima
    GROUP BY Admission
)
SELECT
    p.reading AS "T-CHO",
    p.Admission,
    p.ID AS patient_id
FROM patient_maxima AS p
JOIN group_maxima AS g
  ON g.Admission = p.Admission
 AND g.highest_reading = p.reading
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.ID;

WITH patient_levels AS (
    SELECT p.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS anti_RNP_level
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p."First Date" >= '1991-01-01'
      AND p."First Date" < '1992-01-01'
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
    GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT ID, anti_RNP_level
FROM patient_levels
WHERE anti_RNP_level = (SELECT MAX(anti_RNP_level) FROM patient_levels)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND (`U-PRO` = '300' OR `U-PRO` = '>=300')
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Hospital' ELSE 'Outpatient clinic' END AS care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
      AND CAST(Laboratory."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
  )
GROUP BY CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Hospital' ELSE 'Outpatient clinic' END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (l.RF LIKE '<%' OR l.RF = '40')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

WITH latest_sample AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
latest_scl AS (
    SELECT ID, SC170
    FROM (
        SELECT ID, SC170,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ls.ID
FROM latest_sample AS ls
JOIN latest_scl AS scl ON scl.ID = ls.ID
WHERE ls.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND scl.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`)) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
  AND LOWER(TRIM(RNP)) <> 'negative';

SELECT
    CASE SEX
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
    END AS sex,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
        AND HGB < 7.0
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GOT >= 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE GOT >= 60
        AND RNP IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
        AND LOWER(RNP) NOT IN ('negative', 'positive')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (
    (l.FG IS NOT NULL AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450))
    OR l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4')
    OR (
      l."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
    )
    OR (
      l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(l."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL) >= 300
    )
  );

SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS patient_group,
    COUNT(l.LDH) AS normal_lactate_dehydrogenase_measurements
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE lower(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%aps%'
  AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_any_lab,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_tbil
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'P';

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS h
          WHERE h.ID = p.ID
            AND h.HGB < 10
      )
),
patient_rnp_max AS (
    SELECT ep.ID, ep.SEX, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS max_rnp
    FROM eligible_patients AS ep
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = ep.ID
    WHERE l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
    GROUP BY ep.ID, ep.SEX
)
SELECT ID, SEX, max_rnp
FROM patient_rnp_max
WHERE max_rnp = (SELECT MAX(max_rnp) FROM patient_rnp_max);

WITH first_lab AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        GOT,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, l.Date, l.`U-PRO`
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
  AND l.Date = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
      FROM Laboratory AS l2
      WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
        AND l2.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250
  AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
),
max_gpt AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS highest_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN max_gpt AS m ON m.ID = e.ID
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY m.highest_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16;

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
        SELECT trim(value) AS diagnosis
        FROM json_each('["' || replace(replace(p.Diagnosis, ', ', '","'), '"', '\\"') || '"]')
    ) AS d
    WHERE d.diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT ID,
           CASE Admission
               WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
               WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
           END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND date(Birthday, '+50 years') <= '2026-10-09'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           e.care_setting,
           MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_rnp
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY e.ID, e.care_setting
)
SELECT care_setting,
       SUM(has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4,
       COUNT(*) - SUM(has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_with_no_such_result
FROM patient_results
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ID, IGG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN latest AS l ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.IGG >= 2000;

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, l.DNA, CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS dna_num
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
)
SELECT ID, Diagnosis, DNA
FROM candidates
WHERE dna_num = (SELECT MAX(dna_num) FROM candidates)
ORDER BY ID;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.ID,
        CASE
            WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS setting
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
      AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
ranked_igg AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        IGG,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
),
latest_igg AS (
    SELECT ID, IGG
    FROM ranked_igg
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    c.setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN li.IGG > 900 AND li.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM cohort AS c
LEFT JOIN latest_igg AS li ON li.ID = c.ID
GROUP BY c.setting;

WITH ranked_visits AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference
FROM ranked_visits AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) >= 32;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        RNP,
        CPK,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM ranked AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.rn = 1
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND l.CPK < 250;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS inpatients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_clinic,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) /
        NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN ID END), 0),
        2
    ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%';

WITH qualifying_ldh AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH >= 500
),
qualifying_protein AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CASE
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '>=*'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(`U-PRO`, 3) AS REAL) >= 100
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '+*(*'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(`U-PRO`, INSTR(`U-PRO`, '(') + 1) AS REAL) >= 100
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '[0-9]*'
            THEN CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 100
        ELSE 0
    END
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_ldh AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN qualifying_protein AS u ON u.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01'
  AND "First Date" < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE "First Date" >= '1998-02-15'
  AND "First Date" < '1998-03-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%'
ORDER BY Birthday ASC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(`aCL IgM`), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT
  CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
    Admission,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday))
    ), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM Patient
WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE typeof(RBC) IN ('integer', 'real')
        AND RBC < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission;

SELECT
    CASE SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' END AS sex,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS number_of_patients
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."aCL IgM"), 2)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL
  AND e."aCL IgM" <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND (LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative' OR TRIM(l.RNP) = '0');

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.SM IN ('negative', '0')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination AS e
          WHERE e.ID = l.ID
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination AS e
          WHERE e.ID = l.ID
            AND e.Thrombosis IS NOT 0
      )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN eligible_patients AS ep ON ep.ID = l.ID
WHERE (
    CASE
        WHEN l.`U-PRO` GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS REAL)
        ELSE NULL
    END
) >= 30
   OR l.`U-PRO` IN ('>=300', '>=1000');

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425), 1)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 < 70
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT IN ('-', '0')
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
      BETWEEN 0 AND 49;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) = 'o'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(oxygen_counts.oxygen_count, 0)), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM eligible
LEFT JOIN oxygen_counts USING (molecule_id);

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
GROUP BY element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(occurrences)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS occurrences
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '-'
        GROUP BY element
    )
);

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

WITH carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
fluorinated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) = 'f'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fluorinated.molecule_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM carcinogenic
LEFT JOIN fluorinated USING (molecule_id);

SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'P' AND a2.element = 'N')
   OR (a1.element = 'N' AND a2.element = 'P');

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE lower(element) IN ('p', 'br')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM qualifying_molecules);

SELECT
  1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
  (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006';

WITH molecule_bond_group AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(b.bond_id)
      THEN 'all_single'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT
  bond_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule_bond_group
GROUP BY bond_group;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

WITH bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
all_atom_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM plus_atoms
),
bonded_element_counts AS (
    SELECT p.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM plus_atoms AS p
    JOIN bonded_atoms AS b ON b.atom_id = p.atom_id
    GROUP BY p.element
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT element, atom_count,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY atom_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM bonded_element_counts
)
SELECT element,
       ROUND(100.0 * atom_count / (SELECT total FROM all_atom_count), 2) AS percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY element;

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM bond b
     WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
       AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10';

SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY CASE b.bond_type
  WHEN '-' THEN 1
  WHEN '=' THEN 2
  WHEN '#' THEN 3
END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN lower(a.element) = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    WHEN lower(a2.element) = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id
END) AS atom_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE lower(a.element) = 'cl' OR lower(a2.element) = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id2) AS directly_bonded_atoms
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS s
  ON s.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
 AND s.element = 's'
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = s.atom_id
JOIN atom AS neighbor
  ON neighbor.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS other
    WHERE other.element = a.element
      AND other.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.element = 'n'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = n.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = n.atom_id
    JOIN bond AS b
      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
     AND b.molecule_id = n.molecule_id
    WHERE n.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND n.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT neighbor.atom_id) AS count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM atom AS chlorine
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = chlorine.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = chlorine.atom_id
JOIN atom AS neighbor
  ON neighbor.atom_id = CASE
    WHEN c.atom_id = chlorine.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2
    ELSE c.atom_id
  END
WHERE LOWER(chlorine.element) = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS carcinogenic_percent,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM triple_bond_molecules AS tb
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = tb.molecule_id
WHERE m.label IN ('+', '-');

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IN (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
  )
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a1.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE LOWER(a1.element) = 'c' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'c'
    GROUP BY a1.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.number_of_carbon_atoms,
        ac.number_of_chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(cbc.number_of_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_multiple_bonds, 0) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN carbon_bond_counts AS cbc ON cbc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.number_of_carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY number_of_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    number_of_carbon_atoms,
    number_of_chlorine_atoms,
    number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
    number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE lower(element) = 'y'
)
AND (lower(a1.element) = 'h' OR lower(a2.element) = 'h');

WITH bonds_by_element AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN a2.element
            ELSE a.element
        END AS element,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
      AND (a.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
    GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element, bond_count
FROM bonds_by_element;

SELECT b.bond_type AS bond_kind,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT
             CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
                  THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
                  ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
             END) AS element_pair_count,
       m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind ASC;

SELECT molecule_id
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE lower(element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    a.element,
    COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
